items.headline: Mizuho Upgrades Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle (ALB) from Neutral to Outperform; Barclays initiated Equal-Weight Oct 13, Argus Buy Oct 7, UBS Buy Oct 5.

items.headline: Albemarle gains as Mizuho upgrades stock on surging energy storage demand
items.snippet: ALB shares advanced 4% premarket after Mizuho upgrade citing battery energy storage demand; lithium carbonate seen at $22,500/t by 2027 and $19,500/t by 2028.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform with unchanged $130 PT. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance favorable; 2027 Energy Storage price forecast raised to $21k from $17k; ALB is lowest-cost lithium producer.

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Lithium prices tanked ~80% from late 2022 highs; slowing EV sales and increased supply weigh on ALB. Downward EPS revisions earn Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium up ~67% YoY but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowers lithium company targets after recent spot price weakness, keeps Outperform on ALB; views the group as oversold.
